1.consolidated_definition: Azotar: Sustantivo que designa el acto de golpear con un látigo o una cuerda para castigar o disciplinar a alguien.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Flog.

Noun designating the act of striking with a whip or cord to punish or discipline someone.

Note: In some contexts, this term may be associated with traditional forms of punishment in certain cultures, particularly in Puerto Rico where it is sometimes used to describe corporal punishment.
